import heapq
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression


def task_func(df, feature, target, n=10):
    if feature not in df.columns or target not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("Specified columns are not in the provided DataFrame.")

    X = df[feature].to_numpy().reshape(-1, 1)
    y = df[target].to_numpy()

    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)

    residuals = abs(y - model.predict(X))
    largest = heapq.nlargest(
        n,
        enumerate(residuals),
        key=lambda item: item[1],
    )

    return [index for index, _ in largest], model

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA


def task_func(x, y, labels):
    """Perform PCA on paired x/y values and plot each result with its label."""
    try:
        x_array = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
        y_array = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("x and y must contain numeric values.") from exc

    if x_array.ndim != 1 or y_array.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("x and y must be one-dimensional sequences.")

    if len(x_array) != len(y_array):
        raise ValueError("x and y must have the same length.")

    if len(x_array) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least two observations are required for PCA.")

    if not np.all(np.isfinite(x_array)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(y_array)):
        raise ValueError("x and y must contain only finite values.")

    labels_array = np.asarray(labels, dtype=object)
    if labels_array.ndim != 1 or len(labels_array) != len(x_array):
        raise ValueError("labels must contain one entry per observation.")

    data = np.column_stack((x_array, y_array))
    transformed = PCA(n_components=2).fit_transform(data)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(transformed[:, 0], transformed[:, 1])

    for point, label in zip(transformed, labels_array):
        ax.annotate(str(label), (point[0], point[1]))

    ax.set_xlabel("Principal Component 1")
    ax.set_ylabel("Principal Component 2")
    ax.set_title("PCA of x and y")
    ax.grid(True)
    fig.tight_layout()

    return fig

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import pytz
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(start_time, end_time):
    """Plot daily UTC offsets for predefined time zones."""

    def to_utc(value):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return pytz.UTC.localize(value)
        return value.astimezone(pytz.UTC)

    start_utc = to_utc(start_time)
    end_utc = to_utc(end_time)

    if start_utc > end_utc:
        raise ValueError("start_time must not be later than end_time")

    time_zones = [
        "UTC",
        "America/Los_Angeles",
        "Europe/Paris",
        "Asia/Kolkata",
        "Australia/Sydney",
    ]
    colors = ["b", "g", "r", "c", "m", "y", "k"]

    dates = []
    current_date = start_utc.date()
    end_date = end_utc.date()

    while current_date <= end_date:
        midnight = datetime.combine(current_date, datetime.min.time())
        dates.append(pytz.UTC.localize(midnight))
        current_date += timedelta(days=1)

    _, ax = plt.subplots()

    for zone_name, color in zip(time_zones, colors):
        timezone = pytz.timezone(zone_name)
        offsets = np.array([
            instant.astimezone(timezone).utcoffset().total_seconds() / 3600
            for instant in dates
        ])

        ax.plot(dates, offsets, color=color, label=zone_name)

    ax.set_xlabel("Date")
    ax.set_ylabel("UTC difference (hours)")
    ax.set_title("Daily Time Difference from UTC")
    ax.grid(True)
    ax.legend()

    return ax

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from itertools import cycle


def task_func(df, groups=['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']):
    required_columns = {'Date', 'Value', 'Group'}

    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        raise ValueError("df must be a pandas DataFrame")

    if not required_columns.issubset(df.columns):
        raise ValueError("df must contain Date, Value, and Group columns")

    dates = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    if dates.isna().any():
        raise ValueError("Date column contains invalid or missing dates")

    date_ordinals = dates.dt.date.map(lambda date: date.toordinal())

    _, ax = plt.subplots()
    colors = cycle(plt.rcParams['axes.prop_cycle'].by_key()['color'])
    plotted_groups = set()

    for group in groups:
        if group in plotted_groups:
            continue

        mask = df['Group'] == group
        if mask.any():
            ax.scatter(
                date_ordinals.loc[mask],
                df.loc[mask, 'Value'],
                color=next(colors),
                label=str(group),
            )
            plotted_groups.add(group)

import smtplib

# Constants
TEXT = "Josie Smith [3996 COLLEGE AVENUE, SOMETOWN, MD 21003]Mugsy Dog Smith [2560 OAK ST, GLENMEADE, WI 14098]"
RECEPIENT_ADDRESS = "names@gmail.com"
SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.gmail.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
EMAIL_ADDRESS = "your.email@gmail.com"
EMAIL_PASSWORD = "your.password"


def task_func(
    text=TEXT,
    smtp_server=SMTP_SERVER,
    smtp_port=SMTP_PORT,
    email_address=EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    email_password=EMAIL_PASSWORD,
    recepient_address=RECEPIENT_ADDRESS,
    smtp=None,
):
    """Extract names outside square brackets, email them, and return the names."""

    text = "" if text is None else str(text)
    segments = re.split(r"\[[^\]]*\]", text)

    names = []
    for segment in segments:
        matches = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z]+(?:\s+[A-Za-z]+)*", segment)
        names.extend(" ".join(match.split()) for match in matches)

    message = "Subject: Extracted Names\n\n" + "\n".join(names)

    if smtp is not None:
        smtp.sendmail(email_address, recepient_address, message)
    else:
        with smtplib.SMTP(smtp_server, smtp_port) as connection:
            connection.starttls()
            connection.login(email_address, email_password)
            connection.sendmail(email_address, recepient_address, message)

    return names

def task_func(data_matrix):

        raise ValueError("data_matrix must be a 2D array")
    if data_matrix.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("data_matrix must not be empty")

        data_matrix,

        significant_indices,
        significant_means,
        color="blue",
        label="Significant Means",
    )
    ax.axhline(
        population_mean,
        color="green",
        label="Population Mean",
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("Row Index")

import os


def task_func(img_path, scale_factors=[0.5, 0.75, 1.5, 2.0]):
    if not os.path.exists(img_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image file not found: {img_path}")

    with Image.open(img_path) as image:
        image_array = np.asarray(image)

    original_height, original_width = image_array.shape[:2]
    results = []

    for factor in scale_factors:
        if isinstance(factor, bool) or not isinstance(
            factor, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)
        ):
            raise TypeError("Scale factors must be numeric.")

        factor = float(factor)
        if not np.isfinite(factor) or factor <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Scale factors must be finite and greater than zero.")

        new_height = max(1, round(original_height * factor))
        new_width = max(1, round(original_width * factor))

        output_shape = (new_height, new_width)
        if image_array.ndim > 2:
            output_shape += image_array.shape[2:]

        scaled_image = resize(
            image_array,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            preserve_range=True,
            anti_aliasing=True,
        )

        _, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.imshow(scaled_image)
        ax.axis("off")
        results.append((ax, np.asarray(scaled_image)))

    plt.show()
    return results

import numpy as np
from scipy import integrate
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(func, x_range=(-2, 2), num_points=1000):
    if not callable(func):
        raise TypeError("func must be callable")

    try:
        if len(x_range) != 2:
            raise ValueError("x_range must contain exactly two values")
    except TypeError as exc:
        raise ValueError("x_range must contain exactly two values") from exc

    if not all(
        isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating))
        and not isinstance(value, bool)
        and np.isfinite(value)
        for value in x_range
    ):
        raise ValueError("x_range values must be finite numbers")

    if isinstance(num_points, bool) or not isinstance(num_points, (int, np.integer)):
        raise TypeError("num_points must be an integer")
    if num_points < 2:
        raise ValueError("num_points must be at least 2")

    x_values = np.linspace(x_range[0], x_range[1], num_points)
    y_values = np.asarray(func(x_values))

    if y_values.shape != x_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("func must return one value for each x value")

    cumulative_integral = integrate.cumulative_trapezoid(
        y_values,
        x_values,
        initial=0,
    )

    function_name = getattr(func, "__name__", "function")

    _, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(x_values, y_values, label=function_name)
    ax.plot(
        x_values,
        cumulative_integral,
        label=f"Cumulative integral of {function_name}",
    )

    ax.set_xlabel(f"x ({function_name})")
    ax.set_ylabel(f"{function_name}(x) and cumulative integral")
    ax.legend()

    return ax
